text: This report recommends appointment of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s Vice Chair, Treasurer, and Corporate Secretary.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Appointed the following Officers of the Corporation to hold office at the pleasure of the Board for one year, or until their successors are appointed: a. Vice Chair: Councillor Dianne Saxe; b. Corporate Secretary: Graysanne Bedell; and c. Treasurer: Jehad Aliweiwi.
